description: MR-GAME-DAY simulated loss of the primary region's cell: cut every subnet of the primary cell (gateways, services, Aurora writer, MSK) for 30 minutes. The failover itself is the runbook (docs/MULTI_REGION.md section 5): cell OFFLINE, Aurora Global failover, standby cell ONLINE (services promote in place). Expected: RTO < 5 min, RPO = replication lag (rpo_probe.py check). Replace the ${...} placeholders (tofu outputs of infra/tofu/modules/cell and region).
